newsitem.title: USA: Sprint to buy Paranet for $425 mln - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Sprint to buy Paranet for $425 mln - WSJ.

text.p: Sprint Corp plans to buy closely-held Paranet Inc for $425 million in cash, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Monday's electronic edition, the paper cited "people familiar with the deal" who said the transaction is expcted to be announced today.
The paper said the deal would give Sprint an additional set of services to sell to customers who already rely on the company's phone lines to beam their data from place to place.
The deal would also mark Sprint's first foray into computer systems integration, the paper said.
